description: This PHP source file contains a test class 'LDAPSyncServiceTest' that extends 'KernelTestCase'. It includes several test methods to validate LDAP synchronization functionality, such as fetching entry collections, handling different lookup configurations, processing special characters, and creating system users. The class utilizes mock services, fixtures, and LDAP server configurations to perform integration tests related to LDAP synchronization within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: LDAPSyncServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing LDAP synchronization functionalities within the OrangeHRM system, including fetching LDAP entries, handling various lookup configurations, special character processing, and system user creation.
